lead: Won Hemet's contract to install 113 full-capture trash devices in storm drain catch basins around the city, awarded Oct 13, 2026.
notes: Source: Valley News, Oct 23, 2026 (Hemet City Council 5-0 vote on Oct 13). Small concrete job (catch basin retrofits), so modest volume, but they're a new public works contractor working about 15-20 miles from the yard. Introduce Monarch for dumping broken concrete and buying base on this job and any others they are bidding.
